text:
[LTIM.2.4.1] A `where`-condition is **time-dependent** when its truth value can
change from one pump to the next with no change to the matched facts. Three reads
make it so:

- a **clock read**: `now()` or `monotonic_ns()`, directly or via the `dwell`
  alias of [LEXP.9.5];
- a **series read**: an aggregation of [LSER.16] over a series, written as a call
  or as a companion slot ([LSER.6.3]). Its value moves as the series absorbs
  other facts' samples at the end of each pump ([LSER.8.6]), and, over a window,
  as the clock moves ([LSER.8.8.1]);
- a **zone read**: the resolution of any zone but `UTC` ([LTIM.10.7],
  [LTIM.10.8]), by any operation [LTIM.10.3] lists. Its answer moves as the host
  asserts, replaces or retracts `TimeZoneOffset` facts ([LTIM.10.6]).

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__read
idris.note: A CLOCK READ in a `where`: `now()`, `monotonic_ns()`, or `t.dwell` by the binding's rank. LESS than the clause: the first of its three reads alone; a series read and a zone read are outside the fragment, refused by the fixture lowering. The leaf carries no value: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr substitutes it under the pump's sample and the stamps before this evaluator runs, which traps on a leaf that reaches it.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__due
idris.note: A time-dependent test: the follow-up's guard reads the monotonic clock.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__b_shutters
idris.note: Which chain carries the time-dependent test: B's single positive pattern. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gate_open_match
idris.note: The time-dependent test read at clock 0 admits the pair. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gate_shut_no_match
idris.note: The time-dependent test read at clock 0 refuses the pair. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gates
idris.note: Which chain carries a time-dependent test: A's single positive pattern. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__opens_at_one
idris.note: A time-dependent test: its value at each clock reading. True from clock 1. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__shuts_at_one
idris.note: A time-dependent test, true at clock 0 alone. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__shutters
idris.note: Which chain carries the shutting test: A's. A fixture.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__timed
idris.note: A time-dependent join test: the test at each clock reading.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__timed_state
idris.note: THE TIMED STATE: Rete/NetworkTwoClocks.idr's sampled net -- the clocked net, the wall sample, the entry stamps -- with Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's trackers beside it. What the Idris model runs on.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__ttest
idris.note: A TIMED TEST: Rete/NetworkTwoClocks.idr's two-clock test read from the stamp table -- what a time-dependent `where` is to the engine, a function of the stamps and the sample with the facts fixed.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__at_sample
idris.note: THE SUBSTITUTION: every clock leaf replaced by its literal under the sample and the stamps, the rest of the expression as it is, so that the plain evaluator reads no clock. The sample a read sees is the one the state holds: 'every read between two samples returns the most recent sample'.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__clock_free_unchanged
idris.note: A `where` THAT READS NO CLOCK IS UNCHANGED by the substitution, under every sample, stamp table, token and expression: every untimed test of the Idris model is evaluated as it was before this rung. By induction on the expression.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__loaded
idris.note: THE LOADED TIMED STATE of a program: no rows, no deadlines, the clock at 0, the wall at 0, no stamps, no tracker. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__net_of
idris.note: The clocked net of a timed state, by projections.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__no_timed_rule_is_the_gated_pump
idris.note: THE FRAME: with no rule timed, from a state between actions, the timed pump's net, trackers, halt and trace are Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's gated pump's from the same net and trackers, the stamps and the wall beside; over every program, cooldown list, fuel, state, stamp table and tracker table. Every fixture the Idris model compared before this rung runs through the timed engine, and its agreement holds by this theorem and Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's frame rather than by a rerun: the nineteen smoke pairs stay byte for byte.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__one_timed_rule
idris.note: ONE TIMED RULE over kind 0, action-free, its node loaded with the test at the sample (0, 0) and no stamps. A fixture family.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__one_timed_tests
idris.note: The one timed rule's tests, by ordinal. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__or_false
idris.note: A Bool disjunction false on both sides: the Bool fact the inductions need.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__proj
idris.note: The gated state under a timed state: the stamps and the wall dropped, by projections. What the projection theorems compare through.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__read_at
idris.note: A clock read under a sample and the stamps: `now()` the wall sample, `monotonic_ns()` the monotonic one, `t.dwell` the monotonic sample less the fact's entry stamp. LESS than the clause: the clock read alone, with `now()` held at zero by the runner in this half of the rung (R4b moves it).

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__reads_clock
idris.note: WHETHER A `where` IS TIME-DEPENDENT: a clock leaf anywhere in it. LESS than the clause: the clock read is the one of its three reads the fragment has; a series read and a zone read are refused by the lowering.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__run_steps_timed
idris.note: A FIXTURE'S STEPS on the timed engine in its cadence: a tick, a data input, a pump under its fuel; every pump's verdicts collected. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__test_of
idris.note: THE TIMED TEST OF A `where`: under the stamps and the sample, the substituted expression evaluated over the token and the candidate by Rete/Eval.idr, admitting on `true`. The positive node's join relation, re-timed.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_at
idris.note: The tests fixed at a wall sample over the stamps: Rete/NetworkTwoClocks.idr's `ltim_2_8_4__tests_at` at the program's tests.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_at_untimed
idris.note: WITH NO RULE TIMED THE TESTS ARE NONE: the fixed list is every ordinal's `Nothing`, however the wall and the stamps stand, so the re-time leaves every chain.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_fn
idris.note: THE TIMED TESTS OF A PROGRAM, by rule ordinal: a test for a rule whose single positive pattern carries a time-dependent `where`, none for any other, read over a stamp table. What the lowering builds and Rete/NetworkClocked.idr's tick takes.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tick_untimed
idris.note: WITH NO RULE TIMED THE RE-TIME IS THE IDENTITY on the engine: every chain is left alone.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__untimed
idris.note: No rule timed: the frame theorem's hypothesis. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__verdicts_of
idris.note: THE VERDICTS OF A SCHEDULE from the loaded network: one list per pump. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__wenv
idris.note: THE WITNESSES' ENVIRONMENT: an id stands for the one-slot tuple of the Int it is, except 7, which stands for `null`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__wm_after
idris.note: THE WORKING MEMORY after a schedule from the loaded network. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_3__entry_retime_untimed
idris.note: WITH NO RULE TIMED THE RE-TIME AT ENTRY IS THE CASCADE ALONE, the identity on a state between actions, one where no row has ended -- which every pump boundary is.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_2__mono_test_of
idris.note: The timed test of a `where` that reads the monotonic clock alone, as the runner builds it.

idris.name: Ltim_2_8_4__timed
idris.note: A `where`-condition whose truth can change as either clock moves: a function of the sample, with the facts fixed.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_3__wall_window
idris.note: Time-dependent by reading `now()`: its truth changes with the wall sample and no fact.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__now_gate
idris.note: A time-dependent condition that reads `now()`: `now() > 5`. Time-dependent because it reads `now()`, the clause's criterion.
